channel.title: Release · aibox
channel.description: Reproducible AI workspaces from one aibox.toml.

item.title: v0.35.3 — restore the stable release chain
item.description: Promotes the current v0 code through its development line to main and keeps host validation mandatory.

item.title: v0.35.1 — Yazi Markdown preview and refreshed tools
item.description: Restores rendered Markdown previews and refreshes v0 base-image and addon tool versions.

item.title: v0.35.2 — release-host Yazi probe fix
item.description: Checks Yazi startup in a generated tmux pane so macOS release validation can complete.

item.title: v0.35.0 — period terminal themes and graphics toolchains
item.description: Adds Borland, Norton, and Phosphor themes plus opt-in D2, Graphviz, Vega, Vega-Lite, and Mermaid build-time renderers.

item.title: v0.34.5 — consistent tmux window separators
item.description: Restores PowerKit separator colors across all themes and makes visual regressions release-blocking.

item.title: v0.34.6 — restored host runtime builds
item.description: Accepts PowerKit's expanded pinned renderer while retaining structural separator validation.

item.title: v0.34.7 — configurable Yazi previews
item.description: Adds persistent line numbers and wrapping, explicit preview scrolling, and hierarchical tabular size reports.

item.title: v0.34.2 — accurate themes and reliable agent state
item.description: Adds the theme gallery and chooser, aligns generated themes with their references, and fixes Codex and tmux attention state.

item.title: v0.34.3 — readable themes and restored terminal titles
item.description: Repairs Yazi marks and PowerKit dividers across all themes, preserves active-pane emphasis, and restores terminal titles on exit.

item.title: v0.34.4 — warning-free Yazi pane toggles
item.description: Updates the bundled pane-toggle plugin for Yazi's current ratio API.

item.title: v0.34.0 — agent-aware tmux and branded documentation
item.description: Adds configurable agent lifecycle titles and moves the documentation site to the projectious.work Hugo brand theme.

item.title: v0.34.1 — coherent terminal themes
item.description: Unifies configurable colors across the managed terminal toolchain, restores the theme gallery, and fixes Codex lifecycle and LaTeX builds.

item.title: v0.33.2 — runtime and processkit alignment
item.description: Refreshes processkit and runtime metadata while reconciling tmux layout and theme switching work.

item.title: v0.33.0 — agent-aware terminal titles
item.description: Adds configurable, terminal-neutral tmux titles and lifecycle attention signals for agent panes.

item.title: v0.33.1 — resilient runtime projections
item.description: Repairs generated harness startup, Yazi directory previews, and PowerKit window-tab spacing.
